description: This file defines API interaction functions for frontend communication with a backend server, including methods for GET and POST requests, parameter handling, URL building, and fetching work items. It exports functions for making HTTP requests with error handling and JSON parsing.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error with message.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, handles URL encoding, JSON parsing, and error handling.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items from backend, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Returns the full URL for the given API path using the current base URL.
